messages:
jen: FYI I opened PR to update migration guide + SDK snippet for 1.13. Need quick reviews before next release cutoff. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4999 :hourglass:

maria: Which cutoff are we targeting? Release notes say freeze on 2024-11-01 15:00 UTC.

jen: Target merge by 2024-10-31 12:00 UTC so previews can bake and PMs can sanity-check.

sam: CI preview failed earlier due to example import path change. I pushed a fix to the branch (tests updated).

docs-bot: Preview build queued for PR #4999 4: https://ci.redwood/docs/4999/preview :building_construction:

maria: Also note feature flag ff/new-model-behavior will be at 50% during release. We should put migration guide under /versions/1.13 and add a banner on /latest/ that links to it.

jen: Agreed. I'll update frontmatter and paths to versions/1.13. That avoids confusing users on /latest/.

sam: After path change, re-running preview now.

docs-bot: Preview build complete: success. Linter: 0 errors, 1 warning (long line). Linkcheck: passed.

pm-bot: Reminder: docs deploy blackout 2024-10-31 14:00-16:00 UTC. Avoid merges during blackout.

maria: Approving on content. Please add one short opt-in code snippet showing redwoodctl flag set for staging so folks can test before global rollout.

jen: Added opt-in snippet and small paragraph about rollouts. Rebased and moved files to /versions/1.13/.

sam: All green. Approving now.

docs-bot: PR #4999 approved by sam, maria. Ready to merge.

jen: Merged at 2024-10-31T11:59:02Z. I'll post an update in #release-war-room after deploy completes.

pm-bot: Docsite deploy started: https://deploy.redwood/docsite/2024-10-31-11

maria: PM verified preview content after merge. Versioned guide live at /versions/1.13/migration. Banner on /latest/ added. Thanks all.

jen: I'll also open a tiny SDK changelog PR to point to the new doc path. Done.
